srcClusters.name: safe-storage-windowless-launch-guard
srcClusters.purpose: Round-4 review (Fable, material deviation 3): safeStorage's synchronous macOS Keychain call can hang a windowless launch (ORCA_BACKGROUND_LAUNCH/E2E-headless) forever with no timeout (odin/proofs/ssh-boundary.md Deviation 3) -- fixed by reporting encryption unavailable up front instead of calling into safeStorage. This closes no DIRECTION.md residual or manifest.json id; its only reachable trigger is the proof/test launch flag, documented at docs/reference/windowless-launch-secret-storage.md. Declared here, not in the main clusters array above, because those files sit under src/ -- outside-contract-scope.test.ts's CONTRACT_ROOT_PATTERN already treats src/ as in-contract and never reads this list; it only asserts every path named here still exists.
